presets.title: General
presets.what: The everyday preset: questions, writing, checking things, your own paperwork - one balanced setup instead of a separate admin preset.
presets.cost: qwen3.5:9b sits on the 2060 and holds 196,608 tokens there, taking 9.17 of its 12 GB; nothing else fits beside it. Writing is 44.9 tokens a second, not the fastest.
presets.worse: Not the quickest and not the picture specialist; it thinks before it answers, so a short answer allowance can cut it off before it speaks - at the 1,024 tokens every window gets it answered all of the general, tool-calling and vision checks (6/6, 5/5, 1/1).

presets.title: General Uncensored
presets.focus: general work with the uncensored model
presets.what: General everyday work with the uncensored model, for answers the ordinary model's safety tuning would refuse or water down.
presets.cost: Measured 2026-10-18: cold load 18.5-20.5 s, 45.6 tokens a second at 8k and 45-46 at 16k; 32k loads 7.3 GB at 100% GPU (it only splits across cards when others are resident; no CPU spill). 6.3 GB on disk, Apache-2.0, Qwen3.5 family, 8.95B parameters.
presets.worse: A one-run general rubric of 6 prompts (6/6) is not independent evidence; it did beat the installed qwen2.5-14b fallback on the quality tie and 45.6 against 30.6 tokens a second. Small known nit: it suggested Homebrew on Windows.

measured.source: measurement 2026-10-18: one-run 6-prompt general rubric, 6/6; not independent; 45.6 tok/s at 8k, 45-46 at 16k

presets.title: Coding
presets.what: For writing and fixing code, reading a project, and long tool-driven coding jobs: the 30B coding model on ONE lane that sees all three cards, started on demand by this apply.
presets.cost: HEAVY MODE: it fills ALL THREE GPUs (16.17 GiB of video memory here, with the same q8_0 cache the two live lanes use, and nothing pushed into system RAM) and pauses the other lanes' models while it works, for about 32 s on a cold load. Measured 2026-11-07 at 49,152 tokens on all three cards: 83.8 tokens a second after a 900-word prompt, prompt ~1,644 tokens a second, zero CPU spill. The same-night two-card control (same q8_0 cache) at 32,768 tokens read 60.6 tokens a second with a 69.6 s cold load; the 2026-11-03 shipped record used the default f16 cache and read 80.4 at a 36.0 s load, so it is not a like-for-like baseline. Against the control the three-card window is about 38% faster; against the older record the gain is small - the real change is the 16,384-token wider window with zero spill and no spill allowance. The older figures (76.2 tok/s at 28,672; 80.4 at 32,768 with 323.5 MiB spilled) are kept in docs/MEASURED-2026-11-07-THREE-GPU.md.
presets.worse: Applying it makes it the model chat uses, so the Fast/Live and Agentic+Vision models are NOT resident while it runs - they come back when you apply another preset, and that switch costs a reload. It is not a quick helper: it takes all three cards for as long as it is on, and nothing else can be loaded beside it. Measured about 59 tokens a second at 65,536 tokens, so the wider window is not offered.

measured.tok_s_note: 16.17 GiB, 0 spill, all three cards, 49,152 context; two runs read 40.3-51.2 tok/s, the low end is shown
measured.source: measurement 2026-11-07 on all three cards with OLLAMA_SCHED_SPREAD=1: 49,152 tokens loaded at 16.2 GiB entirely in video memory, 83.8 tok/s warm generation after a 900-word prompt, prompt ~1,644 tok/s, cold load 31.6 s, three cards used (nvidia-smi deltas). The same-night two-card control (q8_0, 32,768 tokens) measured 60.58 tok/s with a 69.611 s cold load and zero spill as well; the 2026-11-03 shipped record used the default f16 cache and read 80.36 tok/s at a 36.0 s load, so the two baselines are not comparable. 65,536 tokens measured 59.06 tok/s and 98,304 measured 88.69 tok/s, both with zero spill; 49,152 is the larger of the two windows the Q2 ruling named (49,152 and 65,536) that clears the 75 tok/s bar - 98,304 was outside those windows and is recorded, not chosen. The 6/6 coding rubric was measured 2026-10-18 on two cards and was not re-run. Evidence: docs/MEASURED-2026-11-07-THREE-GPU.md and .dsh-scratch/GPU-3WAY-2026-11-06/bench/results3/.

presets.heavy_words: This preset needs all three cards at once as one pooled lane. While it runs, the everyday and Fast models are paused - they come back, proved from the model list, when you apply another preset. Loading it takes about half a minute.

presets.title: Agentic + Vision
presets.focus: tools, steps, forms, browser, phone, pictures
presets.what: For work that takes several steps with tools - browser, phone, forms, notes - and pictures: the vision model reads the image, and a picture-capable model stays off the display card.
presets.cost: Measured 2026-10-18: it accepts pictures and answered correctly (minor mislabels of status indicators). Browser: 4.45 s to first token, 25.6 s total. Desktop: 0.89 s first token / 46.9 s total warm, 27.6 s / 70.2 s cold - these are LATENCY, not tokens a second.
presets.worse: Slow on the desktop UI (about 47 s warm, 70 s cold for a full answer), and the faster first-token fallback qwen3-vl:8b-thinking produced NO answer on the desktop UI (all thinking, done_reason=length), so it is only a simple-page option.

measured.source: vision test 2026-10-18: pictures accepted, answers correct (minor status-indicator mislabels); speeds are LATENCY, not tok/s

fallback.note: browser 0.39 s first token / 25.9 s total and exact, but on the desktop UI no answer at 3,000 or 700 tokens (all thinking, done_reason=length) - a first-token option for simple pages only, not the default

presets.title: Fast
presets.what: The quickest preset: qwen3.5:4b on the 2080 SUPER at the 16,384-token window its lane serves, while the 2060 keeps the general model warm for when you switch back.
presets.cost: Measured 2026-10-10 on this same card: 77.1 tokens a second and 4.15 GB of video memory at a 65,536-token window (the file is 3.16 GB on disk). The Fast lane starts at 16,384 tokens today, so this row keeps that window; the bigger measurement is why the card has room to spare.
presets.worse: The small model: fastest measured writer here, and the bench's three short prompts were only called broadly correct rather than scored. Chosen for waiting less, not for care; its first request after a cold load is slow on this card.

measured.tok_s_note: 3.20 GiB, 0 spill, one card (RTX 2080 SUPER), 16,384 context
measured.source: measured 2026-10-10 at 65,536 tokens on the RTX 2080 SUPER (repo restatement: docs/WORK-SETUPS.md:29, jarvis_work.py:262); the Fast lane serves 16,384

presets.title: Reflective Coach
presets.what: For talking something through: a calm listener that reflects what you said first and asks one gentle question at a time. Since 2026-11-18 it thinks on all three cards at once, so a difficult thought gets the whole machine instead of one card.
presets.cost: HEAVY MODE: it needs all three cards at once as one pooled lane and pauses the everyday and Fast models while it thinks. Measured on this PC on 2026-11-09: 15.5 GiB loaded with 0.68 GiB (4.4%) spilled into system memory, 96% in the cards' memory, a 52.0 s cold load and 49.26 tokens a second. No model on this PC has been measured for empathy or reflective quality, and nothing here claims it.
presets.worse: A model choice only - it changes no wording by itself. It is not a therapist: it gives no diagnosis, keeps no therapy record and the crisis help stays exactly where it already is. Applying it pauses the other models for about a minute, so it is for a session of thinking, not for a quick question.

presets.title: Documents & Notes
presets.what: For long documents, notes and study material: the same measured setup as General - qwen3.5:9b on the 2060 with the full 196,608-token window - named so long reading, note synthesis and study guides are one click instead of remembering which preset has the big window.
presets.cost: Same measured setup as General: 44.9 tokens a second, 9.17 of the 12 GB, no spill. The window is the point - it is what stops a long document being cut before the model sees it.
presets.worse: Not the quickest; fine for reading, not for waiting. Same model as General, so this row adds a named choice and the full window, not a different model.

presets.title: Medical Expert
presets.what: For reading clinical material carefully and in calm plain words: lab panels, letters, medication lists and health questions. It is a purpose-trained medical model on all three cards at once. It is not a doctor, gives no diagnosis and replaces no clinician.
presets.cost: HEAVY MODE: it needs all three cards at once (17.31 GiB loaded entirely in video memory, 0 B spilled) and pauses the everyday and Fast models while it runs. It is slow: a 46.8 s cold load and 9.27 tokens a second on the measured coding prompt (11.1 on the measured ~150-word explanation, 7.89 on the four-token answer), so a long answer takes a while. Measured on this PC on 2026-11-09 (model-bench run 20261109-105956, the medgemma window row).
presets.worse: It has NO tool calling - `ollama show` reports no `tools` capability, so it cannot use Jarvis's tools, browser or files. It reports vision (pictures), but its picture quality is not measured here. It is not a doctor: no diagnosis, no prescription and no replacement for your own clinician, and a model trained on clinical text can still be wrong about your case.

recommendations.basis: the agreed 2-GPU mapping is measured; 1 and 3 GPUs are best effort and labelled as not tested

three_gpu_plan.layout: everyday presets keep one lane per GPU (the everyday lane, the monitor card's lane and the headless card's lane); only the on-demand heavy mode pools the cards on port 11450 - Coding, Reflective Coach, Pictures & Screens and Medical - and each pauses the other lanes' models while it runs. Agentic + Vision stays on the everyday card, not the headless one: the 9B weights plus the vision projector need about 7.00 GiB and an 8 GB card with no monitor has 6.65 GiB free, so there is no window at which it fits a headless card

cards.card: a card this PC has not detected

headless card's lane: no 9B lane fits - Agentic+Vision needs about 7.00 GiB against 6.65 GiB free, so it stays on the everyday card

three_gpu_plan.heavy_pooled: on demand, the heavy presets pause those three lanes and load ONE model on the same pooled lane on port 11450 across all the cards: Coding (qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-ud-q3-k-xl at 49,152 tokens), Medical (medgemma:27b at 32,768), Reflective Coach (gemma4:26b-a4b-it-qat at 32,768) and Pictures & Screens (qwen3-vl:30b-a3b-instruct at 32,768). Each is too big for one card, which is why a heavy preset splits one model across the cards; every preset that is not heavy keeps one lane per GPU.
three_gpu_plan.link_note: the third card likely sits on the B550 chipset through an M.2 adapter: PCIe 3.0 x4, maybe x2. A slower link costs loading time, not a lane; each lane keeps its own model.
three_gpu_plan.future_not_a_preset: Qwen3.8-27B pooled to 28 GB across cards is a future 'max quality' experiment only; it is not a preset and no figure is claimed until it is measured.
